name: Kinetic Mono
tagline: Apple-recap kinetic type: SF-style semibold, black / white / #f5f5f7, cut-on entries, 1.1 s holds.

motion.direction: Apple-recap kinetic type. One line in almost every case (at most two), 1–4 words, mixed case, semibold, centred; a type moment every 5–7 s when the speaker carries the beat, otherwise every 2 s; holds of about 1.1 s; entries are done in 8 frames — cut-on, slide or fade, never bouncy; exits cut. Spec numerals as `counter`s (huge, with a tiny label). Photos are straight full-width `imageCard`s (tilt 0). Type never moves with the picture. No outlines, no boxes behind text, no rotation, no stamps, no patterns, no film strips, no lock/reveal.
